arguments.command:
set -e
git add -A && git commit -q -m "release: v0.35.1

- oxfmt 0.77.0 for typescript source formatting
- development: oxlint 1.92.0, vitest 5.1.0" && git push -q -u origin release-0.35.1 2>&1 | tail -2
gh pr create --base main --head release-0.35.1 --title "release: v0.35.1" --body "Release v0.35.1 (tracking: #353).

- \`oxfmt\` 0.77.0 for \`typescript\` source formatting
- Development: \`oxlint\` 1.92.0, \`vitest\` 5.1.0

Validated locally: \`npm run check\`, \`npm test\` (1813 passed), \`npm run package:check\`, \`npm audit\` (0 vulnerabilities), \`npm pack --dry-run\`."
